policy: Upstream sources are pinned to the exact commit that was inspected. Sources A and B are vendored: a curated subset is copied into methods/ and agents/ with provenance headers and the SHA-256 of every upstream file (methods/MANIFEST.json). Source D is installed as a plugin from its pinned commit. A pin or vendored file changes only in one reviewed commit (SOURCES.json, methods/MANIFEST.json and, for D, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json), followed by the full validation suite (evals/). Nothing updates silently.
